obligations.note: POST /payees/{id}/reopen is bound to privileged action manage_payees with mfa=False, while close uses mfa=True. The exhaustive control test fails on that route, and EXC-0203 does not excuse it because Sofia Santos approved her own request and is not a risk_owner.
reopen_payee updates only status and closed_at. Existing NPI columns stay sealed, and test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed on the head commit.
LedgerService.reopen_payee authorizes manage_payees and records an audit event with actor, action reopen_payee, target payee id, and the clock time. The sampled audit control test passed.
The new UPDATE is a fixed SQL string with the payee id bound as a parameter. test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passed on the head commit.
CHG-25340 is approved by change manager Grace Kim and lists payments.http, payments.routes, payments.service, and payments.store, which are the components of the four changed files.
Mara Costa, a payments change_approver and not the author, approved a code_review of 42d355f9a426238111e3dc7e4c8212263a5f5b96.
The change is a single commit, and both the code review and the security review name that head commit.
records/ci/run.json reports failure on the final commit. The payments suite has one failure: tests.controls.test_routes_control#test_privileged_routes_require_mfa.
app.py, routes.py, and store.py are security_sensitive. Ines Halvorsen, a security_reviewer and not the author, approved security_review of the head commit.
The diff does not touch controls data, control tests, or CI, so a control-owner approval is not required.
Ticket CHG-25340 is type standard and the change is not marked emergency, so a post-implementation review is not due.
EXC-0203 is the exception cited for the MFA gap, but it was approved by requester sofia.santos@fernbrook.example. She does not hold the risk_owner role; only the CISO office does.

Acceptance record ACR-0404 covers apps/baseline-payments/payments/routes.py for MFA-1, and this change alters that route table. The replacement exhaustive control test on the head commit failed, so the lapsed evidence is not replaced.

summary: The change adds POST /payees/{id}/reopen for privileged action manage_payees without MFA. The route-table control test fails on the final commit, and the cited exception EXC-0203 was approved by the requester rather than a CISO-office risk owner, so it does not authorize the deviation. Prior MFA evidence covering routes.py has lapsed and was not replaced. Ticket, independent code review, and security review are in order, and the new SQL, audit event, and NPI writes do not themselves break those controls, but the MFA failure is enough to reject.
